2608.16276.title: PolyDebate: A Game-Orchestrated Multimodal System for Debate Skills Practice and Evaluation
2608.16276.paper_summary: Debate is a structured form of persuasive communication that trains argument construction, rebuttal, oral delivery, and audience awareness. These skills are valued in education, language learning, and professional communication. Recent AI debate systems and LLM-based judges have advanced argument generation and debate evaluation, but most remain text-centered and rarely support learners through a complete multimodal practice experience. We introduce PolyDebate, a game-orchestrated multimodal system for English debate practice and evaluation. PolyDebate guides learners through staged one-on-one (1v1) debates with an AI opponent, while skill cards, props, and coins make persuasive strategies explicit and turn practice into a game-like interaction. During each session, the system captures learner speech and visual delivery evidence, generates context-aware opponent responses, and produces rubric-informed stage-level and overall feedback. PolyDebate is available as both an immersive Unity 3D game version and a web platform version that share the same workflow and evaluation services. Four studies covering AI opponent quality, evaluation coverage, AI judge feedback, and user perception show that PolyDebate brings debate interaction, gamified scaffolding, multimodal assessment, and structured feedback together in a practical workflow for debate skills practice. The demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/mHwBG1_8Ebk.
2608.16276.paper_summary_zh: 辯論是一種結構化的說服性溝通形式，訓練論點構建、反駁、口頭表達和觀眾意識。這些技能在教育、語言學習和專業溝通中受到重視。最近的人工智慧辯論系統和基於大型語言模型的評審已經推進了論點生成和辯論評估，但大多數仍然以文本為中心，並且很少支持學習者進行完整的多模態實踐體驗。我們介紹了PolyDebate，這是一個為英語辯論實踐和評估而設計的遊戲協調多模態系統。PolyDebate引導學習者通過與AI對手進行分階段的一對一（1v1）辯論，技能卡、道具和硬幣使說服策略變得明確，並將實踐轉變為遊戲式互動。在每個會話中，系統捕捉學習者的語音和視覺表達證據，生成上下文感知的對手回應，並提供基於評分標準的階段性和整體反饋。PolyDebate同時提供沉浸式的Unity 3D遊戲版本和共享相同工作流程和評估服務的網絡平台版本。四項研究涵蓋了AI對手質量、評估範圍、AI評審反饋和用戶感知，顯示PolyDebate將辯論互動、遊戲化支架、多模態評估和結構化反饋整合在一個實用的辯論技能實踐工作流程中。演示視頻可在https://youtu.be/mHwBG1_8Ebk查看。
